# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia m158 and HarfBuzz 15** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15 and GPU rendering corrections. HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named script constants without changing its struct-based Script API. GPU fixes address reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clipping and displacement precision; the shared hash-code polyfill now seeds its per-process randomness from the operating system.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158 engine** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. The first preview uses HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz 14.4.0; Preview 2 upgrades the engine to HarfBuzz 15.0.0. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634), [#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## API Surface

- **More named HarfBuzz scripts** — Adds 30 Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while retaining all existing fields and values. The Script struct keeps its parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup; no public managed member is removed. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU hairlines, text and clipping** — Corrects reflected zero-length square hairline caps and rounds text-atlas indices before sampler selection. Graphite counts pending clips before flushing and logs and skips draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh pass, preventing pass-capacity overflow. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Vulkan failure-path handling** — Adds a targeted 1 ms device-loss cleanup delay for ARM proprietary drivers from 42 up to, but not including, 56. Native synchronous submission now includes fence-wait failure in its result without changing asynchronous submission; GRContext.Submit remains void with no new managed result. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))
- **Displacement sampling matches bounds precision** — Uses fp32 displacement scale and offset arithmetic to match filter-bounds calculations, avoiding half-precision rounding differences in sample positions. Color samples and channel selectors retain half precision. ([#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **OS-generated hash-code seeds** — The shared hash-code polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp uses RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random for its per-process seed. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Upgrades native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script fields, values and struct-based operations remain available; removing the unused internal deprecated font-face setter import removes no public managed API.

## Preview 3 (November 13, 2026)

Improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait-result handling, without adding a managed submission result. The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated per-process randomness while retaining within-process stability.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5...v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Upgrades HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants. GPU fixes correct reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Introduces the Skia m158 engine without changing SkiaSharp's managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
